'''Abayan''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#The Free Years|Free Years]], founded after the [[Trolloc Wars]] out of the ruins of the kingdom of [[Jaramide]]. It was later annexed as part of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]] and its territory today is occupied by the kingdom of [[Arad Doman]]

==Geography==
[[Image:Abayan.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Abayan was bordered by the [[Aryth Ocean]] to the west and north, the [[River Dhagon]] to the south and the mountains just north of the Dhagon (an offshoot of the [[Mountains of Mist]] to the east. Its neighbors were [[Darmovan]] and [[Oman Dashar]] to the south, [[Indrahar]] to the east and [[Basharande]] to the far north-east.

The precise location and name of Abayan's capital city is unknown. [[Bandar Eban]] lay on its border with Darmovan, but it is unknown where its allegiances lay.

==History==
Little is known of Abayan. It remained free of the [[War of the Second Dragon]], as although [[Guaire Amalasan]]'s power base of Darmovan lay just to the south he instead chose to wage a campaign south and eastwards towards [[Tear]], and paid little attention to Abayan.

Abayan was conquered by [[Artur Hawkwing]] during the [[Consolidation]] and formed part of his empire. During the [[War of the Hundred Years]] Abayan's territory was seized by the growing nation of Arad Doman.
